六级大纲词汇 · 03英文原文

Before the Patient Leaves

在病人离开之前 · 595 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A chronic illness clinic opened beside a rural bus stop. Its old records tracked mortality after an epidemic but rarely mentioned who missed follow-up care. Rosa, the midwife, noticed the gap when Ana arrived with a rash. Ana had conceived after a traumatic premature delivery. Her kidney ailment had been stable before conception, but the rash began after a change in medication. She dreaded a recurrence of that trauma. Rosa asked a practitioner to check both. Ana was susceptible to complications.

2Ana brought a leaflet on maternal health but no prescription. Her sister had suffered an allergic reaction after someone gave her an injection. Ana still remembered seeing the nurse inject it. Ana feared an allergy. The pharmacy had dispensed two new products. To reassure her without guessing, Rosa asked permission to verify both names. One was a pharmaceutical treatment. The other was a cosmetic supplement. The practitioner recorded the onset of the irritation and arranged a review. To ascribe the symptom to one product on the spot would be premature.

3Across the corridor an adolescent waited for spinal rehabilitation. A fracture near his spine had left his thigh numb. He wore a brace and feared paralysis whenever the old pain returned. The specialist asked whether the pain was transient and whether anything impaired his balance. He feared a syndrome he had read about online. Climbing stairs meant agony. The specialist checked the blood test from a vein. She distinguished a physiological response from a possible recurrence. What he lacked was a clear plan for the next visit. He had entered adolescence during treatment, yet staff still gave every instruction to his father.

4The reception protocol required an eligible patient to book before leaving. A vaccination table used a separate system. Staff there could vaccinate visitors quickly and check when a vaccine would expire. Their attention to hygiene and sanitation had helped them contain one contagious disease. Meanwhile people with chronically disabling conditions left with no return date. The nurse at the injection table showed Rosa how she checked appointments aloud. At the hygienic station each visitor left knowing when to return.

5The practitioner reviewed Ana's history. A benign skin problem might explain the rash. An abnormal reading needed a check for a malignant cause or a metabolic problem. A urine test helped assess kidney function and check for changes that might inhibit treatment. She also noted how a gland condition might affect metabolism during pregnancy. Ana asked about a potent antibiotic that might irritate her skin. Rosa explained that different ailments had different causes. She helped Ana arrange a time to discuss the results rather than promise one tablet would alleviate everything.

6Ana began to stammer when Rosa asked about transport. She had endured an ordeal after losing her first baby, and the memory still filled her with anguish. Rosa reserved a seat by the door. Her compassion helped Ana confide in her. A follow-up call could soothe the fear. The boy feared the stigma of a psychiatric referral. A psychiatrist helped staff explain why a referral to psychiatry might be offered without questioning the reality of his pain.

7Before maternity appointments, the clinic now called patients who needed a lift or feared a recurrence of symptoms. It did not prolong visits to add another form. At reception each person said the next step aloud. When Ana returned, the rash had not recurred, and her bruise was healing. She still carried the leaflet. Inside was a card naming the next caller. In a week of dread, that small object was a source of reassurance.

六级大纲词汇 · 03中文译文

在病人离开之前

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1乡间公交站旁开了一家慢性病诊所。过去的记录统计过一次疫情后的死亡率，却很少提到哪些病人错过复诊。安娜起了皮疹来就诊，助产士罗莎由此留意到这个缺口。安娜曾有过一次令人痛苦的早产，后来再次怀孕。受孕前，她的肾病一直稳定。换药后，她开始起疹，担心那段经历重来。她容易出现并发症，罗莎请一位医务人员检查皮疹和妊娠情况。

2安娜带来一本孕产保健小册子，却没带处方。她的姐姐曾在打针后发生过敏反应，安娜还记得亲眼看着护士把药注射进去。现在，她也担心自己过敏。药房最近给了她两种新产品。为了让她放心，罗莎先征得同意，再去核对名称。其中一种是药物，另一种是美容补充剂。医生记下皮肤不适开始的时间并安排复查。当场把症状归到其中一种产品身上还为时过早。

3走廊对面，一名青少年在等着做脊柱康复。靠近脊柱的一处骨折让他的大腿发麻。他戴着支具，每次旧伤疼起来都怕自己瘫痪。专科医生问疼痛是否短暂，有没有什么影响平衡。他担心自己患有网上读到的一种综合征，上下楼对他来说非常痛苦。医生查看了静脉血检结果，区分用力时的生理反应和症状复发的可能。男孩需要的是一份清楚的复诊安排。治疗期间，他已经进入青春期，工作人员却仍把每条指示都告诉他的父亲。

4接待流程规定，符合条件的患者离开前要预约。接种台用的是另一套系统。工作人员既能迅速接种，也会查看疫苗的有效期。他们重视个人卫生和环境清洁，因此曾控制住一种传染病。与此同时，受长期疾病困扰的人却常常没有下次就诊日期就离开了。接种台的护士给罗莎示范了怎样当面确认预约。接种台保持清洁，每位来访者离开时也知道什么时候该回来。

5医生查看了安娜的病史。皮疹可能是良性的皮肤问题。检查结果有一项异常，还需排查恶性病变或代谢问题。尿检有助于评估肾功能，也能了解有没有变化会影响治疗。她还考虑到，腺体问题可能影响孕期代谢。安娜问起一种强效抗生素，担心它会刺激皮肤。罗莎说，不同病症有不同原因。她帮安娜约好讨论结果的时间，避免给出一片药就能缓解所有问题的承诺。

6罗莎问安娜怎么来复诊时，安娜说话开始结巴。失去第一个孩子后，她熬过了一段难关，回想起来仍很痛苦。罗莎在门边给她留了个座位。罗莎的体谅让安娜愿意说出心里话，后续电话也能缓解一时的恐惧。走廊对面的男孩担心转诊精神科会招来偏见。一位精神科医生帮助工作人员解释转诊可能有何益处，同时认真对待男孩感受到的疼痛。

7产检前，诊所现在会给需要搭车或担心症状复发的人打电话。工作人员没有为多填一张表而延长看诊时间，只请病人离开前在接待处说出下一步该做什么。安娜回来时，皮疹没有再发，瘀伤也在好转。她仍带着那本小册子，里面多了一张卡片，写着谁会给她打下一个电话。在提心吊胆的那一周，这张小卡片让她安心了一些。
